items.html: And after Adam HaRishon came and corrected the worlds through his prayer, in the secret of "to work it and to keep it" (le-ovdah u-leshomrah) — behold, until Adam HaRishon came, the six days of action were in the secret of the thirty-nine labors mentioned above, as they were back to back. And then he caused the upper separation (Nesira), and ZON returned face to face, and it was the Sabbath day. Therefore all the thirty-nine labors were forbidden on the Sabbath, for it causes the worlds to return back to back, as at first.
